name: Square
blurb:
Your school Square for parent cards and in-person sales.
Not for Pavilion SaaS billing.

name: Stripe
blurb: HSKRG LLC uses Stripe Checkout and Customer Portal for Pavilion software.
note: Seller of record for Pavilion SaaS.

name: Google Workspace
blurb: Domain and staff email connect during onboarding when the school is ready.

name: Cheddar Up
blurb: Some boards still use Cheddar Up for enrichment until checkout lives in Pavilion.

name: Tax1099
blurb: 1099 and related e-file if the board keeps contractor filing outside Pavilion.

name: Canva
blurb: Staff can open Canva from the board portal. Print vendors stay school choice.

name: Mailchimp
blurb: External blast tools if you keep a list outside the in-app newsletter.

name: MoneyMinder
blurb: External ledger some PTOs keep while official books stay with the treasurer.

name: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer
blurb: Public 990 filings help understand PTO scale. Not a product integration.
